scenarios.label: bull
scenarios.drivers: RI: Ke -1pp, ROE reaches 15.5%; peer re-rates to full SAHI median (no quality discount); GWP growth >=25%

scenarios.label: base
scenarios.drivers: Mechanical blend, adopted with NO discount: 0.70x19.94 (RI/excess-return, primary for a Financial issuer) + 0.30x75.80 (quality-adjusted P/E peers) = 36.70

scenarios.label: bear
scenarios.drivers: RI: Ke +1pp, ROE peaks 12% (never exceeds Ke); peer at 1.0x P/TBV; encompasses the INR 16.12 structural-reset avoid-ruin floor
